main_text.l: doceat & excolat: quæ vero inter hæc habentur media, eorum nul-

page.notes: Greek word on line 4 after "illam" is uncertain: transcribed as ταρικχὴν[?] and should be checked against the scan. "consecten-tur" (line 31) could be "confectentur" in print; read as printed with long s. "otiumq;" is read as otium with q; (-que). Line-number markers 5 to 35 in the left margin are printed numbers, given as notes. Italic spans are approximate where the type changes between roman and italic.
